rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when pressurizing a person or group to make them act.

example.english: The boss is always trying to pressurize us into delivering early.
example.traditional: 老闆成日畀壓力我哋，要我哋提早交貨。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 bei2 aat3 lik6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 tai4 zou2 gaau1 fo3

rows.note: Use this for physically pressing or holding something down rather than pressurizing someone figuratively.

example.english: Please pressurize the paper by holding it down so the wind does not blow it away.
example.traditional: 你幫我壓住張紙，唔好畀風吹走。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 aat3 zyu6 zoeng1 zi2 m4 hou2 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 zau2

rows.note: Use this for applying or increasing pressure in a physical system, container, or technical process.

example.english: The bottle needs to pressurize to keep the soft drink fizzy.
example.traditional: 個樽入面要加壓，先可以保持汽水有氣。
example.jyutping: go3 zeon1 jap6 min6 jiu3 gaa1 aat3 sin1 ho2 ji5 bou2 ci4 hei3 seoi2 jau5 hei3
